Commentary.Commentary: That's all we have from this game. Zimbabwe are right on top and continue to prosper. They would feel they are just one game away from booking a berth for the World Cup. Ireland, well this will be a tough loss to digest. All they can do is work hard and come out harder in their remaining games. It's time for us to pack our bags and make a leave but you can switch tabs if you want to catch some action from the ongoing virtual semi-final between Sri Lanka and Bangladesh where the hosts are staring down the barrel. Have a great weekend. Cheers!

Ireland skipper, William Porterfield says at the halfway stage they were very happy to chase 211 and the boys were pretty confident as well. Is out of words to describe this dismal batting performance and feels they have just let themselves down with the bat.

Zimbabwe skipper, Graeme Cremer says they were a bit nervous at the halfway mark, but knew they could come out and do well with the ball as chasing is a bit difficult on this track. Credits Sikandar Raza for his performance and says he's his Man of the Match without a doubt. Goes on to say his batting and his side's bowling at the start was vital for them. Thanks the crowd for their support and says it means everything to them that they come out and cheer them on throughout.

Man of the Match, Sikandar Raza says he can't believe that they have come out on top. States he went with his head down at the halfway stage but Cremer and his mates motivated and cheered him up. Thanks the crowd and says that they wanted to do well for them. Credits Chisoro and Blessing for offering a good helping hand otherwise the story would have been completely different. Once again praises the crowd and calls them their 12th man and the real deal for them.

A comfortable victory for Zimbabwe. They didn't have a good enough total on the board, but their bowlers produced a splendid performance to wrap the Irish up for an extremely low score. Barring Blessing Muzarabani, everybody plucked wickets with Tendai Chisoro and Graeme Cremer taking 3 each. Ireland could not sustain any decent partnerships. Yes, the wicket was on the slower side but some more application from them would have done them good. Just goes to show how crucial having a player like Sikandar Raza in your team is. He stood resolute with the tail and his 69 proved to be the difference maker in this contest.

OUT! ZIMBABWE WIN BY 107 RUNS! A good, good victory for them. Murtagh gives the charge and looks to clear the mid-wicket fence. But there's not enough power in it to clear the rope. Solomon Mire in the deep runs to his right and takes a fine catch.
Pitched outside leg, the googly from Cremer, it beats the hanging defensive bat of Tim Murtagh and catches him on the pads.

Yorker on the stumps, Murtagh just about manages to dig this one out off the inner edge down to short fine leg. The batsmen take off for the run. There is a throw at the bowler's end but it's well wide.
Works it with the turn into the cover area and calls his partner through for a run.
Slower through the air on off, Tim throws his bat at this and gets it off the inner half through mid-wicket. One run to the total.
Strays it on the pads once more, it's nurdled fine down the leg side this time for a single.
Quicker through the air this time, sliding in on leg, once again beats the flick shot and catches Andy on the pads.
Drifting in as Raza continues from around the wicket, catches McBrine on the pads as he fails to connect with the flick. No harm done.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. The batsmen have picked up a couple of runs.
Wrong 'un landing outside leg, raps the batsman on the thigh pad and goes away. The umpire, for obvious reasons, shut the appeal down.
Full and straight, comfortably played back to the bowler.
Full and outside off, driven to the cover area for nought.
In the air but it falls safely. Tossed up on leg, Murtagh in an attempt to flick closes the face a bit early. Spoons a leading edge but it falls well short of mid off.
Pitches it on a fullish length, worked away to the square leg area for a run.
Tim Murtagh is the last man in.

OUT! Sikandar Raza gets his first of the game! Floats it up from around the wicket, it's slow in pace. Rankin has a wild slog across the line but gets beaten in the flight and misses to connect. It goes under his bat and knocks the bails over.
Into the leg side again. No run taken.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball.
Back again, inside the crease before Andy tucks it to mid-wicket for one run.
Sliding in on middle and leg, Rankin backs away a touch and works it away into the leg side for a single.
Fuller in length and attacking the off stump, Rankin is forward in defense.
Positions himself behind the line and blocks it out.
Boyd Rankin walks out next.

OUT! Only two wickets for Zimbabwe to win this game. Tossed up on the stumps, McCarthy looks to go across the line but gets a big leading edge over the bowler's head. Sean Williams there settles himself under the ball and takes a safe catch.

This was closer! It pitched and hit in line, but the inside edge has saved him there. Googly on off, spins in and catches the back pad of Barry McCarthy. But, much to his delight, the inside edge is taken first.
Full, too full on middle and leg, Andy gets low and slog sweeps it over mid-wicket. One run taken.
Wrong 'un on off, spins away ever so slightly and beats the outside edge of Andy's hanging bat. So close.
Big appeal for an lbw but it's turned down by the umpire. Looped up and it hits the pads of McBrine. Appeal goes up, nothing from the umpire. It pitched outside leg and was spinning further down too.
Full and outside off, driven towards mid off for no run.
McCarthy comes down the track and pushes it back to Raza who throws it back at the striker's end, seeing the batsman out of his crease.
Straighter one just outside off, touch short in length, played away on the leg side. No run taken.
Turning away from outside off, cut down towards short third man for a run.
Fuller in length on middle and leg, driven uppishly through the right of the bowler for a single down to long on.
Quicker one going across, Barry moves a step across to get behind the line and block.
Floated up on middle and leg, swept fine down the leg side for a couple of runs.
Googly dropped short on middle and off, McBrine doesn't pick it up initially but then does well to dab it just beside first slip.
Spinning away after landing on the stumps, pushed into the covers for a single.
Spinning away from around off, McCarthy comes half-forward, presents the full face of the bat and keeps it out.
Quicker one outside off, pushed away from the front foot on the off side.
Barry McCarthy next in to bat.

OUT! The skipp has a wicket! Tosses it right up there, on middle and off, it skids on through and catches Gary Wilson on the front pad. His defense is beaten and the appeal goes up. The umpire doesn't hesitate and raises his finger in an instant. Zimbabwe just three wickets away from victory now.
Goes back and tucks it through square leg to keep strike.
Takes a stride forward and drives it through cover for a single.
McBrine presses forward and blocks it out.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. They pick up a single.
Huge appeal! From around the wicket, landed on leg, Wilson looks to sweep but misses to get hit on the pads. Pitching outside leg, good call from the umpire.
Turning in, flicked towards square leg.
Sikandar Raza, the hero with the bat comes on to bowl.
Andy McBrine is the new man in.

OUT! Run out! Paul Stirling continues to trudge! Big, big wicket and Ireland lose their mainstay now. Zimbabwe are on a roll here, the crowd is elated as well. Stirling punches it off the back foot towards cover and sets off for a single. Raza charges to the ball and seeing this Wilson sends him back late. By the time the Irish opener can turn back, Sikandar fires in a flat throw to Taylor who takes the bails off. It looked out but the umpire refers it upstairs. First look is enough for the TV umpire to rule it out.
A big mix up and Paul Stirling seems to be struggling here. The expression on the face of the Irish opener suggests that he's a goner. Still it's taken upstairs by the umpire...
Turning away from off, stabbed out.
FOUR! Swept away! Tossed up outside off, Stirling sits down and sweeps it neatly through backward square leg for a boundary.
Pushed off the front foot towards mid off.
Googly from Graeme, worked with soft hands towards the leg side.
Floated ball outside off, pushed with an open bat face through point for a single.
PS dances down the track and does well to block the ball.
Flatter and a bit shorter outside off, Wilson punches it past the bowler for a single down to long on.
Goes back and knocks it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Darted in on the stumps, worked around the corner for a single.
Flatter from Williams, pushed towards point.
Slider on middle, Wilson blocks it out into the ground.
Stirling pushes it towards the off side and calls for the single which is certainly not on. Just one from the over.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Tossed up ball outside off, Stirling goes back and pushes it towards cover.
Flatter on middle and off, defended into the ground.
Leg break outside off, driven past the cover fielder for a single.
Googly slipped in by Cremer, Wilson stays back and defends.
Gets down and brooms it through backward square leg for a single to keep strike.
Takes a good stride forward and pushes it away.
Inside edge saves him there! Quicker fuller ball, coming in with the arm, Gary lunges forward to defend but is lucky to get an inside edge on the pads.
Pushes it quicker through the air on middle, Wilson looks to defend but gets an inside edge towards square leg.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Flatter and quicker one on the stumps, punched through cover for one more.
Floated delivery outside off, GW leans forward and smothers it away.
Driven through mid off by the batsman. One run added to the total.
Tossed up delivery outside off, driven through cover for a single.
Landing on off, turning away, left alone from the batter.
Shimmies down the track and pushes it into the same region.
Loopy ball outside off, Wilson moves leg side and drives it towards cover where Raza dives to make a good stop.
Flighted ball outside off, Paul leans ahead and defends it into the ground. The Zimbabwe spinners are running through the overs.
Loopy delivery around middle and leg, worked into the leg side.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Punched towards sweeper cover for an easy single.
On middle, milked down to long on for a single.
Goes back to this one and punches it to cover.

Huge shout but not given! Cremer slips in a wrong 'un, Gary plunges forward to defend but misses to get rapped on the pads. Graeme appeals but it's turned down almost instantly by the umpire. The impact seemed to be outside the line there.
Makes a bit of room and eases it past the man at cover for one.
Fuller and wider outside off, driven along the ground towards long off for a single.
Defended off the back foot gently.
Googly around off, Stirling leans forward to defend but gets it off the inner half through backward square leg for a single.
Flighted ball outside off, driven towards cover for nothing.
Pushes it straight to the cover fielder to end the 20th over with a dot ball.
FOUR! Deft! Quicker and flatter through the air outside off, Gary Wilson sits back and guides it fine to leave the man at short third man stranded.
Darted in on the pads, Wilson looks to work it away but closes the bat face a bit early and ends up getting a soft leading towards cover.
Loops it up outside off, defended into the ground.
Sits deep in the crease and punches it down to long off for a single.
Dances down the track and pushes it to the cover fielder.
Gary takes a stride forward and smothers it away. A maiden to begin with for the skipper.

Good, good ball from Cremer! Everything right about the delivery but only one thing didn't happen - en edge! Drifting in around middle, asking Wilson to come forward and defend but it turns away and beats his outside edge.
Floated delivery outside off, pushed towards point.
Around middle and leg, worked towards the on side.
Bowls the googly and this turns in, Wilson doesn't pick it up but manages to keep it out.
Tossed up delivery outside off, Wilson presses forward in defense.
Greame Cremer to roll his arm over now.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Lunges forward and kills it down comfortably.

FOUR! Inside edge! Paul Stirling comes forward to play for the turn but this one keeps coming in with the arm. It takes the inside edge and evades the leg stump by a whisker for a boundary towards fine leg. Ireland need some more luck.
Stays back and pushes it away towards cover for nothing.
Drops it on a shorter length outside off, punched off the back foot.
Flatter one outside off, cut away towards sweeper cover for a single.

Drinks called! Zimbabwe are all over Ireland at the moment. They have been superb to start with and took no time in ripping through the top order. With the pressure starting to build, the Irish wilted big time as they kept losing wickets regularly. With still 154 needed, Ireland's hopes will be pinned on their opener Paul Stirling who has decided to spend some time in the middle. Can he be the thorn in the flesh for the hosts? Let's wait and find out.
It's the slower one outside off, Stirling lunges forward and taps it away with soft hands towards the cover fielder.
Fuller outside off, arms are shouldered to this.
Angling in from wide of the crease, knocked off the back foot to mid-wicket.
In the corridor outside off, Paul is happy to shoulder his arms.
FOUR! Goodness me, that has come off the middle! Short ball and it sits up at a good height. Stirling with all his might blasts it over cover for a boundary.
Shorter in length outside off, the Irish opener doesn't offer any shot.
Lands it around off, turning away and squaring Wilson up who pokes at it. Gets it off the outer half towards the off side. An excellent start for Williams, a wicket maiden!
Fuller ball on the stumps, blocked into the ground by staying right behind it.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Flatter this time outside off, Wilson tries cutting it but there is extra bounce this time to beat the batsman.
Gary Wilson is the new man in.

OUT! Edged and gone! Sean Williams is off for a celebratory run. Look what this means to him. Ireland have lost half their side and look out of sorts now. Beautifully tossed up outside off, Kevin O'Brien presses forward to defend but the ball turns away just a wee bit and that is enough to catch the edge. The ball deflects off the keeper's pads and it's an excellent take from the big man, Hamilton Masakadza, at first slip with a dive to his left. Ireland need 158 more to win.
Floated delivery around off, defended into the ground.
Sean Williams into the attack.
That was hit hard but to no avail! Short and too much of width on offer, slapped hard towards point where the fielder does well to stop it with a leap.
Fuller and on middle and leg, worked by shuffling across towards mid on for a single.
Back of a length delivery outside off, steered away towards the man at point.
Angling back in on middle and leg, tucked with the angle behind square on the leg side for a single.
Shortish ball outside off, Stirling once again makes a leave.
Outside off, left alone without much fuss.
A water-tight defense from O'Brien to block it out.
FOUR! Easily done! Darted on the pads, Kevin O'Brien bends his back leg and paddle sweeps it past the man at short fine leg for a boundary to bring up the 50 for Ireland.
Cuts this short ball nicely only to find the man at point.
Quicker ball around off, defended back to the bowler.
Flatter ball outside off, punched towards cover.
Loopy delivery around middle and off, Kevin defends it into the off side.
FOUR! Good shot! Short of a length delivery on middle, Stirling gets on top of the bounce and pulls it through backward square leg for a boundary. A much-needed one.
Back of a length outside off, steered down to third man for a single.
Short of a length delivery outside off, Kevin O'Brien hops back and taps it with soft hands towards point.

Almost... almost chopped it on! Back of a length delivery, angling in on middle, Kevin O'Brien hops back to defend but gets an inside edge which goes through his legs and evades the stumps. Hands on heads for Zimbabwe.
Ahead of a length outside off, defended solidly.
Wide! Length delivery on middle and leg, Kevin looks to help it on its way but fails to clip it away.
Uppish but safe! Short ball outside off, Paul throws his bat at it. Gets an outside edge which flies down safely towards third man for a single.
Works it behind square on the leg side for a run.
FIVE WIDES! Flat and down the leg side, Stirling looks to connect but misses and so does the keeper. Difficult for him to take that as it goes all the way to the fine leg fence.
Positions himself perfectly behind the line and blocks it out.
Plays with the turn and pushes it into the covers for a single.
Kevin O'Brien is the new man in.

OUT! Another Irish wicket down! Short ball on the stumps, Niall O'Brien goes on the back foot and pulls. Only manages a top edge which flies towards backward square leg. Blessing from short fine leg runs to his right and takes a superb catch diving for it.
The batsman drives this through the covers. They pick up a single.
Drifting in from around off, on a driving length, played back down the track for nothing.
Angling down leg, Stirling looks to pull it fine down the leg side but gets it off the thigh pad to fine leg. Leg bye taken.
Short and wide, Paul looks to slap it on the off side but gets a bottom edge beside the off pole.
Short ball too straight in line, the pull is helped down to fine leg for a run.
Fraction straight in line, turns it away with the flick of the wrists through the gap on the leg side for a run.
Hangs back and keeps it out off the back foot.
Some extra bounce off the deck. This is something. Landed on a back of a length, just kicks off and takes the leading edge of Paul Stirling's bat.
Powerplay 2 has been signalled. A maximum of 4 fielders will be allowed outside the ring till the 40th over. Also, Blessing Muzarabani is into the attack.
Fuller and outside off, the batsman looks to get some bat on it but fails.
Full and darted outside off, defended out on the off side.
Stays right behind the line and blocks it out.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Looped up and outside off, driven to mid off for a quick single.
FOUR! Spinning away from outside off, Stirling slices this away with a big swing of the arms. Over backward point and away to the boundary line.
Slanting away from around off, no shot offered.
Keeps it tight, quite close to off. Blocked right under his nose.
Length ball targeting the top of off stump, Niall O'Brien offers a firm punch back down the track with a straight bat.
Outside off on a good length, left alone by the batsman.
Fullish in length and outside off, driven firmly through the covers for a couple of runs.
FOUR! Short ball into the body. Niall swivels and pulls it away powerfully across the deep square leg fence for a boundary.
Works it away with the wrists on the leg side for a single.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Niall O'Brien next in to bat.

OUT! He is! Ireland slip further. This isn't good for them. Brendan Taylor and Zimbabwe are ecstatic. Terrific glovework behind the stumps. It's turning down the leg side, Joyce looks to flick but misses and in the process, he for some reason drags his back leg out of the crease. Brendan Taylor is alert to this, he takes the bails off in a flash and appeals. It's taken upstairs and replays show that Ed is gone. No wide is given because the ball went off the thigh pad.
A stumping referral is taken upstairs. Looks like Ed Joyce is gone...
Outside off, looks to make connection but misses.
Outside off, some flight on this occasion, eased down to long off for a single.
Quicker one on middle and off, played back to the bowler.
Ed Joyce is the new man in.

OUT! Wonderful catch from Brendan Taylor! Andy Balbirnie is on his way back! Superb bowling, this! Zimbabwe have got two quick wickets, an ideal start for them. Jarvis goes wide of the crease, hurls it on a length and this one nips back in a touch from outside off. Andy stands tall to defend but the inward movement takes the inside edge and flies to Taylor behind who takes a good diving catch to his left.
Fullish in length and angling in on middle, defended by lunging forward a touch.
Back of a length delivery outside off, blocked sweetly off the back foot towards cover.
Good length delivery, threatening to come back in from outside off but Balbirnie has it covered. So he makes a good leave.
Fuller and angling in on middle, driven towards the man at mid on for nothing.
On a length and outside off, tapped with a straight blade to the cover fielder.
Flighted delivery, dipping in on middle and leg, Paul works it towards the man at mid on.
On the pads, wristed towards backward square leg.
Floated ball outside off, Stirling lunges forward to bunt it down.
Quicker delivery, he's darting it in, Chisoro! Tucked towards short fine leg for one.
Flattish ball on middle, defended with the full face of the bat.
Quicker one down the leg side, flicked through square leg for a single.
Fuller ball, a bit wide outside off, Stirling drives it past the diving cover fielder. The man from mid off is quick to get to his left and stop it. A single to end the over.
Takes a stride forward to this fuller ball and meets it with a straight bat.
In the channel outside off, Paul lifts his bat to let it be.
On a length outside off, Balbirnie guides it down to third man for an easy single.
Good length ball outside off, the newcomer is happy to leave it alone.
Length ball outside off, driven a bit square on the off side for a single.
Fuller and quicker on middle and off, Balbirnie dead-bats it. End of a successful over!
Loopy delivery around middle and off, pushed into the cover region.
Fired outside off, on a shorter length, Andy cuts it to the same fielder.
Tad short again outside off, cut to point.
Andy Balbirnie is the new man in.

OUT! Straight to Raza! Tendai Chisoro strikes to send the opposition skipper back! Didn't deserve a wicket on this ball but somehow will be relieved. He has his hands aloft and celebrates! A half tracker from the bowler, William Porterfield rocks back to pull but much to his dismay he finds Raza stationed at mid-wicket who accepts a good catch. First blood drawn by the Zimbabweans!
Dropped short on middle, Stirling cuts it really late towards backward point for a single.

Good chase from Mire! Fuller ball, moving away outside off, Stirling just lofts it through the line. Gets it over extra cover but had no meat behind the shot. Solomon hares after it as the ball slows down near the fence. He pulls it back before the ball reaches the rope. Three taken.
On a length and outside off, Paul Stirling sans any feet movement looks to punch it away. Ends up mistiming it to the cover fielder.
Fullish again on the pads, flicked to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Fuller on the pads, chipped uppishly towards deep backward square leg for a couple of runs.
Fuller and curling back in on middle, Porterfield looks to flick but the bat turns at the impact. A mistimed on drive to mid on.
Angling away on a length outside off, William shoulders his arms.
Paul Stirling leans forward and blocks it out. A maiden for Chisoro!
Quicker through the air, fired on middle and leg, worked off the inner half to square leg.
Darted around middle and leg, worked towards the man at square leg for nothing.
Stirling comes down the track to nudge it away but misses and is hit near the thigh area.
Slower one around middle and leg, defended off the front foot gently.
Starts off with a slider around middle and leg, Stirling deals it off the back foot.
Tendai Chisoro to bowl from the other end.

FOUR! Shot! Back of a length delivery, angling away a touch, doesn't matter for the Irish skipper. He stands tall and fetches it from outside off to pull it over mid-wicket for a boundary to end the first over.
Back of a length delivery on middle and leg, WP misses his tuck and wears it on the thigh pad.

Superb delivery! Hurls it on a length around off, it straightens off the surface and squares the southpaw up immediately. He looks to have a poke at it and the ball just about whizzes past the outside edge.
Wide! Strangles down leg, William once again looks to pull but fails to get any wood on it.
Back of a length ball outside off, blocked off the outer half to the point fielder.

That's a good stop from the keeper! Short and angling away this time, Porterfield doesn't move his feet and looks to go hard at it. Ekes out a thick bottom edge which goes on the bounce to the right of the keeper who dives to his right and stops it with one hand.

Starts off with a wayward delivery and is lucky to get away with that one! Short delivery down the leg side, Porterfield lifts his one leg up and looks to help it down to fine leg but gets it off the thigh pad to the keeper.

Welcome back for the run chase. The home side is in a final huddle before the players jog out. Paul Stirling and William Porterfield walk out to the middle to open for Ireland. Kyle Jarvis has the ball in hand for Zimbabwe. His experience would be put to test here. A lone slip stands in a catching position. Here we go...
